parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: zh and en. Default value: zh. The value zh indicates Chinese, and the value en indicates English.

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The IDs of the rules that you want to delete.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The microservice namespace to which the application belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse delete-circuit-breaker-rules --namespace default --ids 1 --app-name spring-cloud-a --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse DeleteCircuitBreakerRules --region cn-hangzhou --Ids '[1]' --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace default --AppName 'spring-cloud-a'
